report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate any root-cause candidate. Gateway metrics show low error rate (0.0012), p95 73ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, and INFO 200 logs; only a single ERROR trace span to order exists. Order shows elevated retained memory (340MB, retained_after_gc) but no latency or error signal, and the deployment record alone cannot establish causation. No leak trend or latency evidence is present.
missing_evidence: Time-series memory retention for order across multiple windows to establish a leak trend
Order and downstream p95 latency/error metrics aligned to the alert window
Trace spans from order to payment/inventory/postgresql to localize latency
Deployment timing (change_age_minutes) and pre/post-deploy latency comparison for order 3.3.3
Gateway error-rate and latency time series covering the alert period
